releases.title: Small things that feel better
releases.summary: A fresh maintenance screen that rotates through its memes, a calmer home button, and general performance polish.

changed: The maintenance page got a cleaner layout and now rotates through a set of meme images on each visit.
Tapping the Bleep logo or Home while already on the home feed no longer reloads the page.
The maintenance page is clearer about what stays available to staff while the public site is offline.
updated: General backend performance and stability improvements.
Updated the underlying platform for better performance, security and long-term support.
optimized: Removed an unused external font request, so pages make one fewer third-party network request.

releases.title: A faster media viewer
releases.summary: Images now arrive pre-sized, the viewer no longer competes with the feed for CPU, and the like button only shows the broken heart while you hover a liked post.

added: Server-resized media images: 640 px copies for grids and 1800 px copies for the viewer, generated on demand and cached under storage/app/public/media-cache.
A shared MediaPath helper so the streaming and image-resizing routes reject unsafe paths the same way.
changed: Opening the media viewer pauses anything playing in the feed, and closing it resumes playback.
The viewer only downloads the full-resolution original when the download button is used.
Liked posts show a broken heart on hover, and unliking now restores the normal filled heart instead of leaving the broken icon behind.
The bulletin board keeps its own version log instead of borrowing the Bleep release number.
updated: Media tiles expose separate thumbnail, viewer and original URLs through data-media-src, data-media-view and data-media-original.
Animated GIFs and images that already fit the requested size are still served untouched, with EXIF rotation baked into resized JPEGs.
optimized: Dragging and pinching in the viewer only rewrite the transform, cursor and zoom label when they change, instead of recalculating styles on every frame.
The viewer measures its centre once per gesture instead of reading layout on every pointer move.
Neighbouring slides start downloading during the slide fade-out instead of after it.
Viewer icons render while the page is idle so opening the viewer does not pay for icon work.
Grid thumbnails are 640 px instead of multi-megabyte originals, cutting download, decode time and memory.

releases.title: Media, privacy and mobile polish
releases.summary: Background media playback, follower-list privacy, policy consent toggles, a compact navigation bar and a long list of quality-of-life fixes.

added: Mini player (picture-in-picture) for audio and video with a Return player to post action.
Off-screen media preference: pause, keep playing in the background, or pop out to the mini player.
Resume on view preference for manually paused videos.
Follower and following list visibility: everyone, friends only, or only me.
Terms, Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy documents with consent toggles on registration and sign-in.
Extension badges for uploaded audio, video and image files.
Personal media download preference, off by default.
Bleep analytics in the post action menu for post owners.
changed: Mobile home now stacks announcements and notifications above the feed as collapsible panels.
The navigation bar compacts to icons while scrolling.
Profile account actions are collapsed into a menu and hidden from guests.
Guests who tap like are sent to sign in instead of seeing an optimistic like.
Unread notification counts stay in sync on the bell and the quick notifications panel.
updated: Registration requires the Terms, Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy and age confirmation toggles.
Choosing Remember me also accepts the policy toggles on that device.
Audio and video uploads accept FLAC, ALAC, AAC and additional container formats.
Follower counters are replaced with a private placeholder when the lists are restricted.
Notification fallback polling now runs every five minutes when Reverb is unavailable.
optimized: Lazy media loading and lighter infinite-scroll work.
Mini player layout reads and controls reduce layout thrash while scrolling.
Lucide icon loading is batched through the shared helper.
Comment and new-post animations are smoother and less expensive.
removed: The separate Block User block on profiles; it now lives in the account actions menu.
The idea reaction from the bulletin board.
Raw JSON-only activity rows; activity is now human-readable by default.

releases.title: Notes that can change
releases.summary: Notes can be edited, reacted to and reported, and every note can pick its own paper colour and texture.

added: An emoji reaction bar under each note.
Note reporting and moderator review from the bulletin board.
Optional paper colour and texture per note, with a stable fallback derived from the note id.
Image, audio and video attachments on notes.
changed: Notes can be edited, and the board keeps both the original and edited timestamps.
Editing and deleting a note follow the same windows as bleeps, comments and chat messages.
updated: The board grid supports 1x1, 1x2, 2x1 and 2x2 notes and adapts to the mobile composer.

releases.title: The bulletin board
releases.summary: A public wall of anonymous notes that expire on their own.

added: Anonymous notes with visitor-hash rate limiting instead of stored identities.
Note expiry and archiving, plus moderator removal for reports.
Shareable note links and a responsive board grid.
